caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wooden balustrade consisting of five vertical balusters. Each baluster is ornately shaped with a symmetrical, curving profile and features an oval medallion at the midpoint with a yellow and red floral motif. The balusters are predominantly colored in shades of light brown, with greenish and reddish lines suggesting wood grain or painted detailing. The tops of the balusters are joined by a horizontal, dark brown rail, which appears textured to resemble wood. The bottoms of the balusters are set into a horizontal, rectangular green base, which also has wood grain texture and some indication of wear. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the colored balustrade. There is a signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Choir Rail
